message.jaymospowers.downed.fire_rest: The fire's warmth keeps you. Rest here: your %s still keeps you down
message.jaymospowers.downed.fire_rise: Warmed through by the fire. Hold sneak to get yourself up
saga.jaymospowers.job.escort.0: Walk a courier safely to the next town
saga.jaymospowers.job.escort.1: Keep a pupil safe through a night's vigil at the monolith
saga.jaymospowers.job.escort.2: See a trader's caravan past a sleeping Giant to the next town
saga.jaymospowers.job.escort.3: Carry a fallen fighter back to the master
message.jaymospowers.escort.where.0: The courier needs to reach the town at %s, %s. Keep them close.
message.jaymospowers.escort.where.1: The pupil will climb the stone at %s, %s and meditate from dusk till dawn. Get them there and keep the night off them.
message.jaymospowers.escort.where.2: The trader is bound for the town at %s, %s. Keep the caravan moving, and keep quiet near anything sleeping.
message.jaymospowers.escort.fallen_at: %s says one of the pupils went down near %s, %s. Bring them back here.
message.jaymospowers.escort.ambush: The Ash Rival's lackeys come out of hiding!
message.jaymospowers.escort.vigil_wait: %s waits at the stone for nightfall.
message.jaymospowers.escort.vigil_start: %s begins the climb. Hold the night off until dawn.
message.jaymospowers.escort.vigil_left: Dawn came, but the pupil had left the stone.
message.jaymospowers.escort.giant: %s whispers: "A Giant sleeps by the road ahead. Walk, don't run."
message.jaymospowers.escort.done.0: The courier made it. They thank you and hurry off with the letters.
message.jaymospowers.escort.done.1: Dawn. The pupil climbs down, steadier than before, and thanks you.
message.jaymospowers.escort.done.2: The caravan made it to town. The trader thanks you and turns to her stall.
message.jaymospowers.escort.done.3: The master takes the fallen fighter from you and brings them round.
message.jaymospowers.escort.ward_died: The one in your charge is dead. The job is lost.
message.jaymospowers.escort.lost: You've lost the one in your charge. The job is lost.
message.jaymospowers.escort.too_long: Too long has passed. The escort job is lost.
